title: DrillAI: An AI Workflow for Oil and Gas Data Analysis
summary: Explore the DrillAI walkthrough for well data, monitoring charts, maps, and voice queries in oil and gas workflows.
body_markdown:
Explore the DrillAI product walkthrough for navigating well data, monitoring charts, maps, and voice queries. The demo illustrates the interface; it does not establish a measured improvement in drilling efficiency or safety.


The walkthrough focuses on exploring well records and drill-monitoring information. It shows an interface for working with those records, rather than a field evaluation of drilling performance.


## Add your files


Choose the well records and source data you want to explore. Confirm their units, timestamps, and completeness before comparing results.


The demo includes a well list, a monitoring view, a network map, a bit summary, and voice queries. Evaluate these views against your own data requirements; the demo does not establish production sensor integration, predictive hazard detection, or autonomous equipment control.


## Explore your data


Follow the demo to explore individual well records, including rock composition and rate of penetration (ROP):


[Watch the DrillAI data-analysis walkthrough](https://www.loom.com/share/c80773166b07440a8ba4be28cbc26ec1?sid=759a400c-8099-4d5b-97e3-25df91c62f23)


1. **Select the well you want to see in the list:** on the left side of the page is a list of wells, click on the name of the well to see all the information about the well, such as Rock composition, DT, GR, MINFINAL, UCS, FA, RAT and ROP.
2. **Open the Drill Monitoring page:** scroll horizontally to compare the displayed metrics and vertically to inspect different depths. Check the source timestamps before treating a value as current.


1. **Browse the Well Networks Map page to visualize the comprehensive data of the well network:** about what are the offsite well layer analysis and what are the geo distribution of each of this will.


1. **Browse the bit summary page for comprehensive information about the well:** establishment time, location, bit manufacturer, bit Model, and a summary of data about the drill bit and ROC.
2. **Try a voice query:** ask for information about the well network map, then compare the answer with the displayed records. The example illustrates the interaction; it does not measure response time or answer accuracy.


### Review Monitoring Data


Use the monitoring view to explore the metrics shown in the demo. Before using a similar workflow, confirm the data source, update frequency, units, and missing-value handling. A displayed chart does not establish that live sensor ingestion has been validated.


Compare any derived figures with the underlying records. This walkthrough provides no measured result for drilling speed, equipment lifespan, or route optimization.


### Define the Evaluation Scope


The demo is not evidence of validated hazard warnings or reduced accident rates. Those claims would require a separate evaluation with documented conditions, reference outcomes, and error rates.


Keep operational decisions within the review and control processes established by the responsible team.


### Specialized Voice-Enabled AI Assistant


The walkthrough shows voice interaction with the displayed well data. Test whether the questions, terminology, and source references meet your team's needs.


- Ask a question about a well or the network map.
- Compare the answer with the source records and their timestamps.
- Record missing information or unsupported statements for review.


### Reports and Data Visualization


Evaluate charts and summaries on a representative set of well records. Confirm which metrics are available and whether the outputs preserve the units and context needed to interpret them.


Before estimating a benefit, define a baseline and measure output quality and review effort. This article reports no measured reduction in cost, downtime, or planning time.


## You get a verdict, with evidence


For an Energent.ai analysis workflow, request an independent check against the source files and your criteria. Review the findings and unresolved issues. The DrillAI video does not demonstrate or validate that audit workflow.


## What to Evaluate Before Adoption


Use the demo to decide which data-navigation and analysis tasks to test. Define the expected output, compare it with the source records, and document the results.


- Check the available well records, metrics, and timestamps.
- Test map navigation and voice queries on representative questions.
- Verify exported figures and document any missing information.
- Seek separate evidence before relying on performance or safety claims.
